card.title: Automated interactions on WhatsApp
card.excerpt: A WhatsApp bot that serves, activates and chats with Águila consumers around the clock, with no waiting.

paragraphs: Águila needed to be present for its consumers on the channel they use most, without depending on business hours or a team handling every message by hand.
We built a digital coworker on WhatsApp that automates interactions: it answers questions, runs promotions and keeps the conversation alive 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Handle the high volume of consumer messages without depending on business hours or manual support.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: A conversational WhatsApp bot that automates replies, activations and promotions, available 24/7.

result.label: Result
result.text: An always-on brand that chats with its consumers in real time, with no queues or waiting.
